static_traits.name: 罗拉
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness；not yet接受过心理治疗/咨询
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰，配合度高，愿意尝试结构化练习；能自我觉察并描述trigger情境；语气平稳、态度积极

basic_info.main_problem: 因身高而反复产生“可能永远找not到真正爱自己的伴侣”的想法，近期愈发压倒性，影响自信并在社交与约会情境中引发Anxiety。
basic_info.core_demands: 我决定寻求咨询，因为这些想法开始影响我的社交互动和整体心理健康。我想处理这些not安全感并学习如何建立自信。
growth_experiences: 过去曾因身高遭遇他人拒绝，随后长期出现与身高相关的not安全感与Self-doubt；这些经历在近期被trigger后加重，促使罗拉在Meeting new friends或约会时预先假定会被身高阻碍并Being rejected。

core_beliefs: I am not worthy of being loved
我的身高使我会Being rejected/not被真正接纳

special_situations.event: 上周与新认识的人约会
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我的身高被视为问题，对方就not会想再次见我；若Being rejected就证明I am not worthy of being loved
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 在约会中use积极自我对话与分散注意，但仍难以放松与享受过程
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他not会再见我，因为我太高。

special_situations.event: 在社交活动中与陌生人互动
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人注意到我的身高，他们就会认为我not合适并拒绝我
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 在社交场合降低投入、避免谈及not安全感以减少被评价的风险
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会觉得我的身高是个问题。

special_situations.event: 朋友称赞并羡慕我的身高
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 正面反馈not算数或not够真实，without法negate被拒经历

special_situations.event: Recalling past experiences of being rejected because of height
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 一旦过去发生过拒绝，not yet来也会重复发生
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Using negative memories as evidence to maintain caution and low expectations, reducing the possibility of being hurt again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 过去都这样，以后也会一样。

core_conflict.wish: 渴望在亲密关系中被真实地看见与without条件地被爱
core_conflict.fear: 害怕因身高而Being rejected、羞辱与negate，自我价值被击碎
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of rejection and emotional hurt by staying cautious, lowering expectations, and downplaying positive feedback

object_relations.self_representation: 容易被挑剔、可能not被爱的高个子Female
object_relations.object_representation: 潜在的拒绝者/挑剔的他人

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor proposes a more positive hypothesis or encourages a behavioral experiment (such as 'someone will appreciate your height')
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 潜意识认为积极反馈not可靠，最终仍会因身高被拒（将过去经验Projection到当下）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 采用温和、Empathy的语气，先验证感受，再逐步探询证据差异；避免直接反驳，use开放式问题引导其区分具体情境与总体化结论。

manifestations: 担心因身高永远找not到真正爱自己的人
在结识新人或约会时Anticipation被拒
not与朋友讨论not安全感，独自承受担忧
outcomes: 对亲密关系的期待下降与Withdrawal

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves.
manifestations: 有一小圈朋友但not与他们讨论身高相关的not安全感
将寻求支持的冲动收回到自我安抚与忍耐

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact.
manifestations: 通过分散注意力来回避对not安全感的直接接触
用积极自我对话Displacement焦点而非正面接触Anxiety

positive_force: Positive attitude, willing to participate in structured behavioral experiments to test beliefs
具备一定自助策略（积极自我对话、分散注意）
存在友人对其身高的正向评价与潜在支持资源（虽尚not yet充分利用）
negative_force: 灾难化预测与过度概括（将过往拒绝推及not yet来）
negate正面反馈与心理过滤，Reinforcement负性自我图式
社交情境中Anticipation被拒导致Anxiety与Withdrawal
not与朋友讨论not安全感，外部支持动员not足

target_behavior.behavior: 在Meeting new friends或约会时出现显著的Social anxiety并Anticipation被拒
antecedent: 见到新的人或进入约会场景
Recalling past experiences of being rejected because of height
target_behavior.core_reason: 将过去的拒绝归因为身高，形成对not yet来的灾难化预测与过度概括的认知模式
target_behavior.function: 逃避潜在的拒绝与情感伤害，维持Self-protection
target_behavior.consequence: 难以享受社交与约会、降低自信、进一步影响Interpersonal relationships发展

target_behavior.behavior: negate正面反馈（对身高的赞美与欣赏）
antecedent: 朋友或他人对身高的称赞与羡慕
target_behavior.core_reason: 负性核心信念“I am not worthy of being loved”与心理过滤导致without法整合正向信息
target_behavior.function: Maintains a defensive negative narrative to avoid the disappointment after expectations are shattered
target_behavior.consequence: Self-esteem difficult to improve, negative cognitions continuously consolidated, affecting intimate relationship beliefs and behaviors
